headline: Screamer documentation corrected, with PAL v2.00 still fully code-matched
summary: The Screamer enemy’s documentation now says it retreats to its spawn point after diving at a target, rather than dying. It only enters its death state after lethal damage. This changes comments only, leaving PAL v2.00 at 100.00% matched code and 5,116 of 5,116 matched functions.
highlights: The generated-name readability proposal #161 closed without merging.
New reports describe Linux visual glitches and launcher freezes in OpenRAC 0.10.0 (#162, #164). Separate issues request surround sound and HRTF (#163) and report a disc-extraction failure (#165).
